visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal year-by-year timeline slider over a background photo, active entry highlighted
notes: Full-bleed sunset mountain photo; uppercase white "OUR STORY" top-left, round prev/next arrows top-right; horizontal timeline line with dots and year labels; translucent cards, the active one cream with dark text. Photo background belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.

contentPattern.structure: optional first single-cell row = background image; then one row per entry, single cell: bold year paragraph + milestone paragraph(s)
patterns: optional first single-cell row = background image
year label + milestone text per card
timeline line with dots, active card highlighted
blockContent: 7 timeline entries 2019-2025, each year + 1-2 short milestone sentences; horizontal slider with arrows over a background photo

reuseGuidance: Use for dated milestones on a timeline line. Use cards-slider for image cards in a horizontal scroller.
